title: Attackers Reportedly Used ARTEX, an AI Security-Testing Tool, to Steal Data from South Korean Financial Institutions
summary: An unidentified attacker reportedly used ARTEX, an AI-powered security-testing tool, alongside large language models to breach South Korean financial institutions and steal data. Compromised systems included a loan-broker inquiry service and an employee mobile work-support system. Researchers linked the activity to exposed attacker infrastructure and AI session histories. The attacker’s identity and the full number of affected institutions remained unconfirmed.
